v.placement.sound.text: Look at the letters on the card. Say the sound they make.

v.placement.word.text: Read this word out loud. Take your time.

v.placement.thanks.note: warm, even; the same every time

v.placement.paper.text: Now your grown-up will say some words. Write each one on your paper.

v.placement.done.text: Thank you, apprentice. That is all for now.
